reviews.title: Terrible Level of Functionality with Basic Subscription
reviews.text:
I paid for a month of basic access to the app for $11.99.  At first it was nice as I was able to create a plan for an upcoming two-week road trip.  The problem was that even with a paid basic membership, I lost access to that plan after just a week.  To access it after a week, they require another upgrade to the “premium” subscription.  

I felt VERY scammed by this subscription purchase and DO NOT recommend a subscription at ANY level as the subscription price is far too expensive.

reviews.title: I hate this app
reviews.text: So much potential and even more disappointment. The biggest problem is that to change the dates of your trip you have to edit each stop, and when you do this they get out of order and no matter what you do, the app will not put them in any logical driving order. The lack of editing options is infuriating. App is very glitchy and waypoints appear and disappear on the map for no reason. Could be great if there was better integration with Google Maps, and Yelp. Both are linked but show such minimal information that you need to exit this app to view anything. Another missed opportunity would be to also link an app like gas buddy so as you travel you could also have access to gas prices to make your choice. Disappointed and angry that I paid for a premium annual subscription.

reviews.title: No longer enjoy app

I paid to upgrade to the next tier and still had a ton of issues using the app. I canceled the app but since it’s paid for the year, I was supposed to still have the same level of service but the app is acting like I have a basic account or no account. Everything I try to do it gives me an error message that I need to upgrade. I also dislike that it isn’t smart enough to recognize what day of your trip you’re on so you constantly have to scroll. Makes the app pointless at this point.

reviews.title: No refund for an app I tried for 2-3 days
reviews.text: I meant to sign up for a free trial, but accidentally subscribed for a month instead. I was looking for an alternative to Google Maps, tried the app for a couple days and found Google Maps to work better for me. I would’ve been happy to pay for the month of Roadtrippers if I liked it, but I was done with it. When I went to cancel what I thought was my free trial within the 7 days and realizing I’d unintentionally subscribed for a month and without a free trial- I contacted customer support right away. They have refused to offer a refund. I think it’s ridiculous and feel like I’ve been scammed because I hit the wrong button. Had I clicked on the year subscription instead of the month they say it wouldn’t have been an issue, but then again I wouldn’t have been charged cancelling within 7 days, so of course not- that’s why I needed actual customer support to reverse the charge. It was not clear to me that the month subscription doesn’t include a free trial. I think this is confusing and takes advantage of those who aren’t as tech savvy.

reviews.text: Did the trial and forgot to cancel (probably the only way they get people to join). On a 6 wk roadtrip I tried repeatedly to get some value from it but it gave nothing but garbage. The map view is the most godawful digital map leaving off city names and making road names/routes so tiny they can't easily be read. Find things near me--they gave me things at the other end of the country, and Alaska!!! Yeah that's nearby to Arkansas. Reviews for places are VERY old. A 2014 review is worthless in 2026. Camping suggestions were sketchy looking RV parks. Nothing about this app is friendly or useful. Don't waste your money.

reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text:
We went on a 7,000 mile road trip. Mostly to national parks and roadside attractions. I thought this app would aid us in finding things to see and do. However, it was useless the entire time. The info is mostly from 2015. Things have changed, places have closed or became unsafe or run down. 
More things to see and do show up on my Apple map in comparison. Don’t waste your money on this app. I wish I could request a refund. Zero value!!!

They responded and agreed with me. That it’s outdated. Where’s my refund?

No refund whatsoever. They said it had been over 3 days. I didn’t see how old the information was until I tried to use it. Please be careful- I hate wasting money. Guys road trips are special; this app is worthless.

reviews.title: Awesome concept…but no action
reviews.text: Great concept but is the clunkiest app to use.  Need a mapping interface with Google or Apple Maps. Can’t find places (state high points) easily.  Have to draw down into location and then it’s hard to set as a waypoint.  The AI feature is good until it repeats itself or suggests things within 5 miles of my house to stop at….seriously for a 3k trip I am going to stop after driving 5 miles.  Suggests things way  to far off normal path.  Need to set main things first and than add easy side treks after.  Not user friendly.  Finding places to stay…what’s that?  Finding places to eat…must not need to eat.  Having better luck with AI apps than. This.  I upgraded to premium.  I wasted my money. I wish I could get a refund.  Bad interaction (actually none existent) while actually doing the trip.  Regret paying for this app.
